text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: C.B., Ace... What is all that luggage for?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Well, it's a long story, but...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I went out for a walk in the city earlier, 
and it got so fun that I started running, 
which is when I bumped into Ace running 
the perimeter...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I was running alongside C.B. while 
shouting, "It's your birthday today, 
right? Happy birthday!!" and before we 
knew it, both of us got totally lost...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
While looking for the way home, I found a 
shrine holding a festival, and I just had 
to check it out.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
And then Ace said, "I'll treat you to 
whatever you want!" so I thought I'd give 
the shooting gallery a try.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's your spoil of war... A 
single grain reaping a ten-thousand-fold 
harvest.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
C.B.'s amazing, you know! Even with a 
stance where it looks like she'd never hit 
a thing, she knocks 'em down one after 
another!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Ace was amazing too. Whenever I pointed 
and said, 'Ooh, I want that one,' she shot 
down every single prize for me."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I had so much fun that I 
ended up playing way too much.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad to hear it was an enjoyable 
birthday. —As for my present, I shall give 
it to you in a more private setting.
